proof_body:
by
  intro p a b hp h4 hd
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hz : ((a : ZMod p)) ^ 2 + (b : ZMod p) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) p).2 hd
    simpa using this
  have hb : (b : ZMod p) = 0 := by
    by_contra hb
    exact ZMod.mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_sq' hb (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hz) h4
  have ha : (a : ZMod p) = 0 := by
    rw [hb] at hz
    simpa using hz
  exact ⟨(ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd a p).1 ha, (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd b p).1 hb⟩
